title.en: A Concrete mixer map of the printed B500S-83D Two-Stage Structure Pump line
title.zh: 用《混凝土搅拌机》给已印的B500S-83D 两级结构泵画一张目录

description.en: B500S-83D Two-Stage Structure Pump is restated under Concrete mixer. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes B500S-83D Two-Stage Structure Pump. The published table prints Type Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric; Motor Power 7.5 kW; Rated Voltage 380 V; Delivery Height 5 m; Horizontal Delivery Distance 5 m; Boom Short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom; Applicable Materials Sand and small stone, 5–16 mm; Delivery Hose Standard; Dimensions (L×W×H) 915 × 550 × 550 mm; Net Weight 280 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: B500S-83D 两级结构泵放在《混凝土搅拌机》的结构下重述。邢台河北品锦机械公布B500S-83D 两级结构泵。已公布参数表印有：型式两级结构泵，手动 / 电动；电机功率7.5 kW；额定电压380 V；垂直输送高度5 m；水平输送距离5 m；臂架本机短臂架，不是车载布料杆；适用材料砂与小石，5–16 mm；输送胶管标准；外形尺寸915 × 550 × 550 mm；整机重量280 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
